what: Photo tiles are stacked on the inside face of a cylinder (radius 900 · pulled forward 540 · perspective 1100, tile width 250 · gap 34) in columns with height ratios 1.33 · 1 · .8 · 1.6 · 1.25 · .75 in turn, for browsing (CSS 3D). It rotates by itself at 7° per second and flows upward 22px at a time, the head turns 24° toward the cursor and tilts up and down (perspective anchor ±9%, vertical ±70px, follow 1−.0004^dt). If the cursor stays outside 78% of the width for .45s, it pushes that way at up to 14°/s. Drag (0.09°/px) and horizontal wheel (×.9) have inertia (.04x per second), .35x while the cursor is moving, and it stops over a tile. Hovering a tile brings it 70px forward, the photo scales 1.04x in .3s, and the name tag follows 14px to the lower right of the cursor. When scrolling a panel chosen by open (1 when the panel’s top edge rises 90% of the screen, τ .1s), the tiles scatter outward from the screen center, come 160px forward and vanish. At first they fly in from 500px behind, starting with the center column, in .9s with cubic deceleration. Phones under 760px use .6x size

options.open: CSS of the panel to scatter on scroll (e.g. .hero — set the panel height to 240svh and pin this motion part element inside it at 100svh) — without it nothing scatters
options.look: Head turn toward the cursor (°), default 24
options.radius · push · focal · width · gap: Cylinder radius 900 · pull-forward 540 · perspective 1100 · tile width 250 · gap 34 (based on 1440 width, scales proportionally when wider)
options.suffix: Text to add after the label, default ” · case study”
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Tile source (one link holds one photo or video, data-name is the label) — hidden, then cloned and cycled through each column slot
options.fx:world · fx:pause · fx:play: Each Frame { open, time } Event announcing it · Pause · Release

note: Dragging is this part’s job, so only horizontal drags on tiles are captured — pushing vertically scrolls the page (axis detection 8px). With many tiles (columns × cells) the DOM runs to hundreds, so video tiles are advised to keep the poster only. With reduced motion it doesn’t spin and stands without flying in

from.where: index.html .bk-stage — original World (wh-world) wall of 36 photos·videos
